desc:
Uncompromising Performance: Delivers monster-level output with up to 10,000 lumens of floodlight and a 750-meter throw of spotlight.
Compact Body: As a flashlight, the Marauder Mini 2 is compact, with a length of 133 mm and a body diameter of 43 mm, allowing for a firm one-handed grip and consistent high performance.
Five Lighting Configurations: A bright floodlight, a focused spotlight, a combined spotlight + floodlight, a subtle red light, and a convenient side light deliver clarity, confidence, and convenience in any situation.
Extended Runtime: Powered by a 7,500 mAh high-capacity battery, it provides up to five months of runtime in moonlight mode for the side light.
Innovative Controls: Features an intuitive triple-control system—rotary selector, toggle switch, and rotary knob—enabling quick and seamless switching between light modes and brightness levels
